breaking_news.headline: Eastern Kentucky welcomes data centers in hopes they make up for coal losses
breaking_news.summary: In Kentucky's former coal country, data centers are a welcome sight as people hope they will bring in money.

breaking_news.headline: A Binance engineer thought he was interviewing for a job. Then the hackers pounced
breaking_news.summary: North Korean hackers pulled off the biggest cyber heist ever by duping a Binance engineer into thinking he was being recruited for a job, the crypto exchange says.

breaking_news.headline: Legendary photographer on getting that perfect election night picture
breaking_news.summary: On election night, photographers will be in position, ready to snap history-making moments. It's something Pulitzer-prize-winner photographer David Hume Kennerly, has done for decades.

breaking_news.headline: Does the blue wave mean lower gasoline and diesel prices soon? Don't hold your breath
breaking_news.summary: A new Democratic majority in Congress could pressure the president to end the war in Iran. But it will be harder for them to directly affect fuel prices, which are tied to a complex international oil market.

breaking_news.headline: As budgets tighten, people are breaking out their library cards
breaking_news.summary: Some Americans squeezed by high prices are relying more on their local libraries for things like books, streaming services and high-priced items like musical instruments and sewing machines.

breaking_news.headline: First-time homebuyers remain scarce, but a record share of them pay all cash
breaking_news.summary: A new report finds generational wealth is widening the divide between homebuyers and those priced out. The median age of first-time buyers also remains at a record high.

breaking_news.headline: Pasture mealybugs have killed off huge swaths of grasses in the Southeast
breaking_news.summary: An invasive insect that's tough to detect and eliminate poses a multi-billion dollar threat to the agricultural economy — adding another stressor to farmers already stretched by high costs.

breaking_news.headline: Fears of an AI crackdown after midterms spark $2 trillion rout in tech stocks
breaking_news.summary: Shares sank, with the tech-heavy Nasdaq dropping over 5%, as investors reacted with fear that a Democratic Congress — and states across the country -— would crack down on AI and data centers.

breaking_news.headline: Paraguay President Santiago Peña resigns after bank collapse
breaking_news.summary: The move follows a bank collapse and after the lower house of congress voted in favour of pursuing an impeachment trial against him.

breaking_news.headline: Chris vs Chris: Who's running and what's at stake this New Zealand election
breaking_news.summary: New Zealanders will head to the polls on 7 November to elect a new government, with rising cost of living a key concern for voters.

breaking_news.headline: Macau jails pro-democracy campaigner in city's first national security case
breaking_news.summary: Au Kam San was sentenced to 12 years and six months' jail for "subversion against the political power of the state".

breaking_news.headline: California governor commutes sentences for state's 548 death row inmates
breaking_news.summary: California has historically had the largest population of people on death row in the US.

breaking_news.headline: Trump signs order preventing future presidents from changing Oval Office
breaking_news.summary: The order comes after Trump made a series of big changes to the decor of the Oval Office and tore down the White House East Wing.

breaking_news.headline: Pope begins lengthy trip to Latin America weeks after lung cancer surgery
breaking_news.summary: Pope Leo, who had part of a lung removed last month, will visit Uruguay, Argentina and Peru.

breaking_news.headline: White House denies Hegseth and Rubio to leave jobs after Republican election losses
breaking_news.summary: US media reports there are calls to replace Pete Hegseth, who also faces a possible impeachment vote, while Mark Rubio is rumoured to be eyeing a presidential run.

breaking_news.headline: Drunk and dangerous e-bike riders face on-the-spot fines under crackdown
breaking_news.summary: A consultation will consider fines and other ways to clamp down on dangerous e-bike riders.

breaking_news.headline: Three ways the interest rate rise could affect you
breaking_news.summary: Job, loans and savings are all affected by the rise in interest rates announced by the Bank of England.

breaking_news.headline: The engine parts that 'fight the laws of the universe'
breaking_news.summary: Investment has surged into the making of jet turbine blades - an extremely difficult component to make.

breaking_news.headline: Faisal Islam: How high will interest rates go?
breaking_news.summary: The BBC's economics editor views one more interest rate as likely, but thinks that will be all.

breaking_news.headline: Interest rates hiked to 4% in first increase in over three years
breaking_news.summary: Most analysts expected the increase from 3.75% to 4%.
